title: The Standing Post and the Peat Paths — the Fenmarch
caption: The only Fen place a dry man is shown: the carved post and the dry boards where reeves settle fines standing up, the reeve's stone with its peat-block niche, the loose board with the reed beneath, the huts on posts, the meres and black peat, the ways east to Mud End, south to the Peat Line and north-west toward the Quiet Acre, which is set down in words and drawn nowhere. Surveyed and inked in Y.H. 813, the month of Bone.
